title: Normalized derived direct-image local classes on integer K-injective complexes
statement: Let f:X→Y be a morphism of ringed spaces whose module-sheaf categories have chosen derived categories. Let I be an integer K-injective complex on X, K a derived object, r:K≅Q(I), and q an integer. Put D=f_*, F=abelian presheaf sections, P=D⋙F, J=D(I). Let b identify inverse-open hypercohomology of K with H^q(P I) using r, the recorded resolution comparison for identity_I, and homologyFunctorFactors. Let d identify H^q(Rf_*K) with H^q(J) using r, the published rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso, and homologyFunctorFactors. Then b.inv followed by topEdgeLocalLeray.inv, topEdgeLocalClass at Rf_*K, and F(d.hom) equals the abelian sheafification unit on H^q(FJ) followed by the underlying map of localSectionComplexSheafificationIso(Y,q,J). All comparisons are exactly those of [lem-weil-pbc-derived-adjunction-top-edge] and [lem-trf-unbounded-direct-image-section-presheaf].

source.place: Tag 01E4, lemma-describe-higher-direct-images, bounded-below-complex local class calculation; Tags 0BKJ and 0D5X

proof.text: Apply the local Leray unit equation on the K-injective complex I. This identifies the inverse recorded direct-image resolution comparison with the derived-section unit on J.
Compare the recorded and published direct-image resolution models by the supplied-representative normalization. Transport the Leray equation by r and take homology.
Use local-class naturality to transport along the published resolution isomorphism. Apply the local-class formula for the derived-section unit and cancel homologyFunctorFactors.

theorem directImage_integer_localClass
    {X Y : RingedSpace.{u}}
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective]
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X)))
    (r : K ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj I) (q : ℤ) :
    let D := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f
    letI : D.Additive := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage_additive f
    let F := RingedSpace.localAbelianSections Y
    let P := D ⋙ F
    let J := (D.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I
    let b := (RingedSpace.inverseOpenHypercohomologyPresheaf f q).mapIso r ≪≫
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).mapIso
        (P.rightDerivedFunctorOfQuasiIsoResolutionsObjIso
          (RingedSpace.localSectionsEnoughKInjectives X) (𝟙 I)) ≪≫
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors _ q).app _
    let d := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).mapIso
        (D.rightDerivedFunctor.mapIso r ≪≫ D.rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso I) ≪≫
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors _ q).app J
    b.inv ≫ (RingedSpace.topEdgeLocalLeray f q K).inv ≫
        RingedSpace.topEdgeLocalClass Y q ((RingedSpace.derivedModuleDirectImage f).obj K) ≫
        F.map d.hom =
      (sheafificationAdjunction (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).unit.app
          (((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj J).homology q) ≫
        (sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).map
          (RingedSpace.localSectionComplexSheafificationIso Y q J).hom
